comment: Anything the automation cannot see. Sales agents announce slates in trade
press months before TMDB has a record, and a few distributors block scrapers
outright, so this is the escape hatch.
Entries here win over anything TMDB found with the same title.
Only `title`, `date` and `sources` are required. `date` is ISO (YYYY-MM-DD);
use the first of the month if all you know is the month.
